brief: Prioritise outstanding work orders for Langmere Lock 230/34kV ahead of the forecast heat event by addressing failed or degraded forced cooling, obstructed ventilation, or oil level and leak defects first, as set out in SOP-016. If category 4 oil condition defects cannot be completed before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, in accordance with MG-023. Record every applied de-rating along with its reason, value, and period as required by MG-021.
